name: milestone-counter-list
title: Milestone Counter List
description: A follower or fan milestone: a rolling odometer counts up to a total while a list of named entries flies past and settles on the last one, with an accent star and underline.
useWhen: Celebrating a milestone: a count-up odometer lands on a total while entries fly past.
A social-proof scene needs a believable list of supporters or early users next to a big number.
You want one self-contained card that pairs the list fly-through with a synced counter.
avoidWhen: You only need the number to roll up without a list: use rolling-number.
The metric is a comparison between values: use a chart block.
You need a growth dashboard with a chart: use followers-overview.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Subject
variables.description: Small line under the counter (name of the project, page or account).

variables.label: Total
variables.description: Number the odometer counts up to.

variables.label: Entries
variables.description: Semicolon-separated rows, each "Name|Date text" (date optional). Shown in order; the last row is highlighted and numbered with its position.
variables.default: Ada Rowe|Mar 4, 2021; Ben Ito|Jun 12, 2021; Chloe Park|Sep 21, 2021; Dev Rao|Dec 8, 2021; Eli Novak|Mar 17, 2022; Fay Lund|Jun 29, 2022; Gus Okoye|Sep 14, 2022; Hana Sato|Dec 23, 2022; Ivo Marin|Mar 9, 2023; June Wells|Jul 19, 2023; Kai Moreau|Nov 2, 2023; Lena Voss|Feb 15, 2024; Milo Duarte|Mar 4, 2021; Nia Hart|Jun 12, 2021; Omar Silva|Sep 21, 2021; Pia Berg|Dec 8, 2021; Quin Alder|Mar 17, 2022; Rhea Cole|Jun 29, 2022; Sol Varga|Sep 14, 2022; Tess Quinn|Dec 23, 2022; Uma Pillai|Mar 9, 2023; Vik Larsen|Jul 19, 2023; Wren Cho|Nov 2, 2023; Zoe Ferrer|Feb 15, 2024

variables.label: Orientation
variables.description: Counter beside the list, or above it. Auto follows the host's shape.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the star, underline and highlighted row.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the card sits over your own scene.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed multiplier; above 1 the scene plays faster and holds the end.
